scientific_integrity.assumptions: Deterministic mean-field reflecting nearest-neighbor incremental persuasion, augmented by positive symmetric spontaneous adjacent hops; all integers k>=1.
scientific_integrity.proved_claim: Exact unique exploration threshold, all-equilibrium classification, global trajectory convergence, local stability, polarized second-moment identity and square-root onset.
scientific_limitations: No assertion for finite-population stationary distribution or stochastic switching times.
No complete description of the uniform saddle stable manifold.
One related 2021 noisy-voter full text inaccessible; possibility of unindexed stronger implications remains.
Finite numerical checks supplement but do not establish the theorem.

title: A sharp exploration-noise transition in incremental multistate opinion dynamics
